verdict.rationale: Sentry's API docs list a "Bulk Mutate a List of Issues" endpoint, so many issues can be updated at once programmatically, which an AI agent could call. Issue status and triage docs cover the states these bulk changes would set. The evidence is a bare title, though, and covers only issues; nothing shows bulk actions through the MCP server or CLI. missing for 10: details of bulk endpoint scope and limits, bulk operations on item types beyond issues, bulk actions exposed via MCP/CLI for agent workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
